verses.text: The desert and the dry land will be glad, and the desert plain will rejoice and blossom like the rose.

segments.text: The desert and the dry land will be glad, and the desert plain will rejoice and blossom like the rose.

verses.text: It will blossom profusely and rejoice even with joy and singing; the glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon—they will see the glory of YHWH, the splendor of our God.

verses.text: Strengthen the limp hands and make firm the feeble knees.

segments.text: Strengthen the limp hands and make firm the feeble knees.

verses.text: Say to the hastened of heart, “Be strong, do not fear! Behold your⁺ God—He comes [with] vengeance, with the recompense of God He will come and save you⁺.”

verses.text: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped;

segments.text: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped;

verses.text: then the lame one will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute one [will] sing. For waters will burst forth in the wilderness, and torrents in the desert plain;

verses.text: and the parched ground will become like a pool, and the thirsty land like springs of water; in the abode [where] jackals once lay, [will be] grass with reeds and papyrus.

verses.text: And a highway will be there, and a way, and it will be called the Way of Holiness; the unclean will not pass over it, and it [is] for those walking the Way, and fools will not wander it.

verses.text: No lion will be there, and the violent beasts will not go up on it; it will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk it.

verses.text: And the ransomed of YHWH will return, and will they will enter Zion with singing, and with joy everlasting on their heads; joy and gladness will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
